title: Astra 6 High is EATING UP TOKENS MAD!
author: Beginning-Sign1916
selftext: Anyone started using Astra 6 for any 3D game dev? I just tried it earlier and within 5 mins it eat up the 5 hour limit on High which is like crazy!! All I got was the beginning of a simple base setup for a three.js game then move on to getting the models done in blender based on image reference. And my 3D model is still not complete cause I am waiting for the next 5 hour cooldown. At this point I am seriously considering using Astra 6 mainly for assets generation and I will switch to medium or even light as long as I get the models that I want else it's just not practical

comments.author: 0bscuris
comments.body:
I think the natural evolution of what is going to happen is: you use local models, dumber models, to do the grunt work, then you use the top end paid models to fix and implement. 

For example i have super grok and if i use grok build, i can blow through my tokens in a day. Not ideal. I don’t buy more tokens cuz this is a hobby for me. 

So, what i’m trying now is: i have grok convert my rambling playtest notes into a prompts, grok maintains the api documentation, then i put the documentation and the prompts into my local, it spits out code. Grok reviews and imports the code. 

My understanding is that input uses alot less tokens than output. I’m still testing though but i think this is the workflow future for anyone who doesn’t have stupid money.
